edges.reason: claim uses _msgSender() as the claimer and proof subject
claim reads and updates the claimed mapping for _msgSender()
claim invokes token.safeTransfer on the stored token
claim requires availableAmount to satisfy minAmountToClaim via the enough modifier
claim consumes the boolean returned by verifyMerkleProofs
verifyMerkleProofs reads merkleRoots[_merkleRootIndex]
transfer recipient in claim is msg.sender
availableAmount is the value transferred by safeTransfer
claim executes the external token transfer call
withdrawToken executes the external token transfer call
withdrawToken reads token balance and calls safeTransfer on token
setMinClaimAmount is guarded by onlyOwner which compares _owner to _msgSender()
setMerkleRoots is guarded by onlyOwner which compares _owner to _msgSender()
withdrawToken is guarded by onlyOwner which compares _owner to _msgSender()
pause is guarded by onlyOwner which compares _owner to _msgSender()
unpause is guarded by onlyOwner which compares _owner to _msgSender()
external token transfer to an arbitrary caller can re-enter claim before/around state finalization
_amountAllowedToClaim parameter drives the claim computation
_merkleRootIndex selects the root used by verifyMerkleProofs
_merkleProofs is the proof array consumed by verifyMerkleProofs
_account is hashed into the verified merkle leaf
claim forwards _merkleRootIndex to verifyMerkleProofs
claim forwards _merkleProofs to verifyMerkleProofs
_recipient is the destination of the withdrawn token amount
_token parameter is assigned to the token state variable in initialize
_minAmount parameter is written into minAmountToClaim
_merkleRoots parameter is stored into the merkleRoots array
